description: A React component for a modal dialog that manages user groups, including searching, filtering, pagination, and creating new groups within the Mattermost application.

methods.name: doHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show state to false.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Fetches groups based on page and group type, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Handles search input change, updates search term.

methods.name: loadMoreGroups
methods.description: Loads additional groups for pagination based on current filter.

methods.name: goToCreateModal
methods.description: Opens the modal to create a new user group.
